2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in a case in connection with Kishanpur P.S. Case No. 133 of 2024 dated 03.06.2024, registered for the offences punishable under Section 366A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Later on, Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of POCSO Act were added.
3. As per the prosecution case, on 31.05.2024 at Patna High Court CR.

dt.07-11-2025 about 12:00 AM, the co-accused Vikash Chaudhary is alleged to have called on the informant's mobile phone and talked with the informant's minor daughter and called her outside and after that the informant's minor daughter is traceless.

sentences.text: the co-accused Vikash Chaudhary to enquire about the matter, Vikash Chaudhary along with the other co- accused persons was missing and the informant came to know from the neighbours that all the accused persons have fled away to Nepal on a four wheeler.
The informant suspects that the co- accused persons may sell his daughter for human trafficking.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners are innocent and they have falsely been implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that there is no specific allegation of any assault or overt act attributed against the petitioners, rather the main allegation is against the co-accused Vikash Kumar.

The victim girl was recovered and in her statement recorded under Section 180 of the BNSS she has stated that the co- accused Vikash Kumar called on her mobile and on the pretext of marriage she voluntarily went with him to his friend's plastic factory where the co-accused Vikash Kumar sexually abused her.
The petitioners have clean antecedent as mentioned in paragraph no. 3 of the bail application.
5. Learned APP for the State has vehemently opposed Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.36699 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 the prayer for anticipatory bail petition of the petitioners.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances as well as the nature of allegation against the petitioners, let the petitioners named-above, in the event of their arrest / surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned District & Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge,
POCSO Act, Supaul, in connection with Kishanpur P.S. Case No. 133 of 2024, subject to conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the BNSS.
7. This application stands allowed.

(Chandra Prakash Singh, J) Shahnawaz/-
